verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers media modalities, bitrates, simulcast, data messages and PSTN/SIP features. Nothing in it documents media regions, points of presence, edge networks, or clients connecting to a nearby media endpoint. Media-transport geography is a fair question for a real-time communications SDK, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a platform engineer, clients connect to a nearby point of presence and the vendor documents the regions or edge network that carries media
